native_oracles.manual_reaudit: The driver uses settings-panel-driver.click('button','Re-audit'), waits for the running and settled states, then re-reads public DOM and native SEO state; the source remains at the selected Wikipedia URL.
native_oracles.clipboard: Controlled T07/T14 paths use trusted button clicks, real navigator.clipboard.readText(), exact expected-text checks, and verify read permission restoration.
native_oracles.outbound_navigation: The door helper verifies a unique visible anchor, expected href, target=_blank, hit-tested stable coordinates, dispatches CDP mousePressed and mouseReleased, observes a new page at the exact URL, and checks the source page remains open and unchanged.
native_oracles.public_navigation: Wikipedia and Airbnb fixture visits use page.goto in the owned browser tab; they are real top-level navigations but not simulated user clicks. Current page response plus NavigationTiming are read as the performance oracle.
